subject: Build/mod theme-spotlight piece organized around the article's single editorial hook — glow traveling up through a switch's frosted top, into a keycap, out through a translucent case wall — rather than three unrelated part diagrams. Left: a 65% keyboard case outline (580x270, rx20) with a dashed gasket/shell-seam channel and an inset bezel, standing in for the Ikki68 Aurora's frosted polycarbonate gasket-mount shell. Inside the bezel: a 13x4 main key field (one key deliberately omitted from the grid loop and redrawn separately), a variable-width bottom row, a slim 3-key right-edge column (Del/Home/End), and an inverted-T arrow cluster — the compact 65% signature with no dedicated nav gap. One key (row 1, column 9) is drawn as the 'glow key': coral fill, coral outline, a small coral dot standing in for the LED point source, and a fan of five coral rays of decreasing opacity rising from the key up through and past the case's outer top edge into the margin above — depicting ambient glow diffusing outward through the translucent shell. A soft coral wash ellipse sits behind the case's top wall at that point for the same reason. A dashed coral leader with a hollow origin dot and an arrowhead runs from the glow key rightward to a switch callout. The switch callout (900-1020 x 210-344) is a simplified housing — top housing, a lighter dashed inset standing in for the switch's frosted light-guide top, a stem, and a simplified bottom housing (no spring or PCB detail, deliberately less literal than a full exploded cross-section per the brief) — with its own fan of three coral rays rising from the frosted inset toward the margin above it, depicting light about to pass into a keycap, captioned 'gateron pro 3.0 yellow'. Below both: a row of five Cherry-profile keycap side silhouettes (shallower slope and flatter crown than the SA profile used in sibling pieces) resting on a shared desk line, alternating between a pale neutral wash fill and a plain outline, standing in for the GMK CYL Ramune set's pastel doubleshot caps without introducing a second hue. The middle cap is the hero accent: coral wash fill, coral outline, and a tiny sunburst mark (three short rays + dot) on its top surface echoing the case's glow key. A dashed coral connector with a hollow origin dot and a filled terminus runs from the switch callout's base down to the hero cap, visually continuing the light's path from switch to keycap. Row captioned 'gmk cyl ramune'; case captioned 'ikki68 aurora'. Bronze theme dot at the upper-right margin (1148,70) with a small coral satellite dot for family cohesion.
composition: Build / mod motif per bearings.md Article hero art directive, following the mission-control-theme-build.svg precedent of pairing three named parts with dashed leaders/connectors into one cohesive theme-spotlight piece. Per this brief's explicit guidance, the switch callout is deliberately simplified (housing + frosted inset + stem + bottom housing, no spring/PCB/sound-arc detail) rather than a full exploded cross-section, since the editorial device here is the glow motif (sunburst rays repeated at the case, the switch, and the hero keycap) rather than switch mechanics.
